Meanwhile, the rules are swinging back.

2024–25

The six largest US banks leave the Net-Zero Banking Alliance.

Aug 2025

The alliance suspends its activities.

Mar 2026

EU Omnibus in force: sustainability reporting narrowed to the largest firms; climate transition plans dropped from due diligence.

Sources: Directive (EU) 2026/470; press coverage of NZBA exits (2024–25).

External: good intentions aren’t enough.

99%

of Danone’s shareholders back its purpose-driven “Société à Mission.” June 2020.

9 months

later, the same shareholders push CEO Emmanuel Faber out. March 2021.

Without an economic case, commitments don’t survive a bad year.

Four moves to manage the Green Disruption.

1

Make the case

Why must we act, and why now?

2

Redefine value

Where can we create value that also pays?

3

Recognize constraints

Why is that value hard to capture?

4

Reinvent the business

Which partners, models and technologies unlock it?
